# Margot — product context

Last updated: 2026-10-04.

## Overview

Margot is a wardrobe app and an AI-assisted personal stylist operated by YAVREN. It helps people find outfit ideas from clothes they already own. It is available on iPhone and Android.

The name Margot refers to the magpie in French folklore. The brand's focus is making better use of existing clothes and helping people decide what to wear in daily life.

## How it works

1. Add photos of clothing to a digital wardrobe. Start with everyday tops, bottoms and shoes; the rest can be added over time.
2. Get outfit suggestions from those clothes, with the weather in mind. An outfit is prepared before the time the user gets dressed, and more can be requested. With Premium, suggestions can also follow calendar events or a chosen occasion. Suggestions start from three pieces (a top and a bottom, or a dress).
3. Save looks, change a piece, and log what was worn. The user makes the final styling decision.

The free plan allows up to 15 pieces, 5 outfit generations a day, one avatar try-on a week, one purchase verdict a day, two resale listings a month and one trip plan. Premium removes the 15-piece limit, raises these limits (for example 20 outfit generations and 15 try-ons a day) and adds event outfits and wardrobe gap analysis. Check Before You Buy returns a buy / consider / skip verdict from a score based on outfits the piece would make, near-duplicates, gaps it fills and the user's profile. From any piece's page, Margot can write a Vinted listing (title, description, hashtags, price range) that the user copies into Vinted; there is no automatic listing. There is no social feed, no follower system and no data export.

The homepage includes an interactive before/after styling scene showing the same fictional woman and man in different outfit combinations. These generated editorial images are labelled as illustrative, not customer testimonials or proof of a virtual try-on result. App preview images are presented separately.

## Availability and price

- iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/app/margot-outfit-planner/id6766047882
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vestiaire.app

Free to download, with a limited free version and an optional Premium subscription. No free trial. Prices observed on 4 October 2026: US App Store $14.99 a month, $59.99 a year, $8.99 a week; France (App Store and Google Play) €14.90, €59.99, €9.90; UK App Store £12.90, £59.99, £8.90. Prices, quotas and terms are displayed in the application before purchase. Do not assume that one numerical price applies to every currency or store.

## Privacy and account control

Users choose the images they submit. Data is stored on servers in London (UK), and photos are analysed by Google Gemini for the app's features, as stated in the privacy policy. The privacy policy describes storage, processing, retention and deletion rights. This product summary does not imply that all operations happen on-device, that no submitted photo is stored, or that every provider processes data in the same region.

- Privacy: https://www.margotwardrobe.com/privacy
- Confidentialité : https://www.margotwardrobe.com/fr/confidentialite
- Account deletion: https://www.margotwardrobe.com/delete-account
- Terms: https://www.margotwardrobe.com/terms
